# Oxford: smooth fit to log-odds ratios
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_1.oxford
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model {
    for (i in 1 : K) {
        r0[i] ~ dbin(p0[i], n0[i])
        r1[i] ~ dbin(p1[i], n1[i])
        logit(p0[i]) <- mu[i]
        logit(p1[i]) <- mu[i] + logPsi[i]
        logPsi[i] <- alpha + beta1 * year[i] + beta2 * (year[i] * year[i] - 22) + b[i]
        b[i] ~ dnorm(0, tau)
        mu[i] ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    }
    alpha ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    beta1 ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    beta2 ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    tau ~ dgamma(1.0E-3, 1.0E-3)
    sigma <- 1 / sqrt(tau)
}
""", false)

build_model(data, inits = (;)) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data, inits)
